basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old Pokémon Go enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. I've been catching 'em all since the game launched and love participating in local raids. When I'm not out hunting for Pokémon, I work as a graphic designer for a startup. I enjoy creating digital art and often share my creations on platforms like Instagram. I'm a night owl, usually online after 9 PM. I'm single and enjoy connecting with fellow gamers and Pokémon fans around the world. I have a mild obsession with collecting shiny Pokémon and love discussing strategies for raids. Besides Pokémon Go, I'm also into PC building and frequently upgrade my gaming rig.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong knowledge of Pokémon Go mechanics, including raid strategies and event planning, mostly acquired through extensive gameplay and community involvement. Additionally, I'm knowledgeable in graphic design and PC hardware, thanks to my educational background in digital media and a passion for DIY projects.
